articles.title: Bank of Canada holds policy rate at 2.75%, signals patience on cuts
articles.summary: The central bank kept rates unchanged for a third straight meeting, citing sticky core inflation and a resilient labour market.

articles.title: TSX closes at record high as energy and financials rally
articles.summary: The Toronto Stock Exchange's benchmark index gained 1.2% Thursday, led by gains in Suncor and RBC.

articles.title: Canada and EU finalize critical minerals trade pact
articles.summary: The agreement secures long-term access to lithium and nickel processing capacity in exchange for tariff relief on EV parts.

articles.title: UN climate talks extend into overtime as emissions targets stall
articles.summary: Negotiators from over 190 countries failed to reach consensus on binding 2035 targets before the scheduled close.

articles.title: Ottawa announces $2.3B rural broadband expansion
articles.summary: The federal program targets 400 underserved communities, with Northern Ontario and Interior BC prioritized for 2027 rollout.

articles.title: Waterloo startup's fusion reactor prototype hits sustained plasma milestone
articles.summary: General Fusion rival Novara Energy says its test reactor held plasma stable for 6 minutes, a new record for a Canadian facility.

articles.title: Apple confirms on-device AI model for iOS 20, no cloud processing required
articles.summary: The feature runs entirely on the A20 chip's neural engine, addressing longstanding privacy concerns with cloud-based assistants.

articles.title: Blood test detects Alzheimer's biomarkers 8 years before symptom onset
articles.summary: A multi-site trial of 4,200 patients found the plasma p-tau217 test matched PET scan accuracy at a fraction of the cost.

articles.title: Health Canada approves first oral treatment for peanut allergy in children
articles.summary: The immunotherapy pill showed a 78% reduction in severe reaction risk across a two-year pediatric study.

articles.title: James Webb telescope finds strongest evidence yet of liquid water on exomoon
articles.summary: Spectral analysis of Europa-class moon K2-18c suggests subsurface ocean conditions compatible with microbial life.

articles.title: Canadian researchers grow functional lung tissue from stem cells
articles.summary: The University of Toronto team says the lab-grown tissue could shorten transplant waitlists within a decade.

articles.title: VIA Rail adds high-frequency Toronto–Montreal service ahead of 2027 schedule
articles.summary: Trip times drop to 3 hours 45 minutes on the new corridor, with departures every 90 minutes at peak.

articles.title: Banff announces shuttle-only access for Moraine Lake starting next summer
articles.summary: Parks Canada cites overcrowding and parking gridlock; a new $8 shuttle will run from Lake Louise every 15 minutes.
